_about: The Agentic Site Framework as data. asf.py reads this to check gates and say what's next; the /asf command reads it to run a stage. Paths are relative to the client project root. Check types are documented in orchestrator/README.md.

stages.title: Truth
stages.question: What is true about this business, and what can we prove in public?

checks.label: Goal document filled (no [brackets] left)
checks.hint: Fill it from the kickoff call; templates/goal-document.md

checks.label: Current-site audit done
checks.hint: Prompt 01 with the site-researcher agent. No current site? `asf skip G1 audit --reason "no site"`

checks.label: Business arc written in the client's words
checks.hint: Prompt 02 (truth harvest) with the site-researcher agent

checks.label: At least 5 claims, each with a source and status
checks.hint: Prompt 02; every number, name and quote gets a row

checks.label: At least 10 verbatim lines in the voice bank
checks.hint: Quote the founders and their customers; never paraphrase

checks.label: Every image in content/media/ is in the truth file's image map
checks.hint: Open each image and record what it really shows (truth.md §6)

checks.label: Competitor and reference teardown done
checks.hint: Prompt 03 with the site-researcher agent

manual: The client signed the goal document
The founder agrees with the business arc
Constraints (white-label, names that can't appear, regulated claims) are written down

stages.title: Story
stages.question: What do we say, to whom, in what order, on which page?

checks.label: Strategy written (no [brackets] left)
checks.hint: Prompt 04 with the site-strategist agent

checks.label: The client's own words choosing the message are recorded
checks.hint: Ask which route defines their business; quote the answer

checks.label: Information architecture done
checks.hint: Prompt 05 with the site-strategist agent

checks.label: Page briefs written (at least 3)
checks.hint: Prompt 05; one brief per page from templates/page-brief.md

checks.label: Every brief has 8 sections or fewer
checks.hint: One idea, one home: link instead of repeating

manual: The client chose a messaging route and said it defines their business
The defining line fails the competitor test
Every recurring idea has exactly one home page

stages.title: System
stages.question: How does it look, and how does it work?

checks.label: Client facts file filled (entity.php)
checks.hint: Fill inc/entity.php from the truth file first

checks.label: Design brief written from the raw data
checks.hint: Prompt 07: geography, buyer, category codes, price, their own world

checks.label: Three design directions compared
checks.hint: Prompt 07; the client chooses

checks.label: The client's own design layer is in place
checks.hint: Write the chosen design into assets/css/brand.css + theme.json

checks.label: Content lint: no errors
checks.hint: Fix what lint_content.py reports

manual: Designer review passes the anti-AI-look checklist
Not a re-skin: palette, type, layout and components differ from the wireframe and from other clients
The client approved the home page and one inner page in the browser

stages.title: Ship
stages.question: Is it right, secure, fast, accessible, finished and deployed?

checks.label: Strict lint: no errors and no [CONFIRM] chips left
checks.hint: Get every [CONFIRM] answered by the client, or remove the claim

checks.label: Crawl: no errors
checks.hint: Fix what crawl.py reports (status, H1, meta, schema, links)

checks.label: Deployed to staging
checks.hint: Deploy (docs/07-deployment.md), then `asf set deploy.staging_url https://…`

checks.label: Accessibility scan: no errors (alt text, names, labels, language, zoom)
checks.hint: Fix what launch.py reports; then run qa/contrast.js in the browser for colour contrast

checks.label: Security scan on staging: no errors (HTTPS, headers, exposed files, login-name leaks)
checks.hint: Fix what launch.py reports; set ASF_WP_USER and ASF_WP_APP_PASSWORD to include pending updates and risky settings

checks.label: Performance budget on staging: no errors (response time, compression, page weight, images)
checks.hint: Resize and compress images first; then caching and compression at the host

checks.label: Launch settings on staging: robots, sitemap, real 404s, privacy link, no local URLs, forms and email
checks.hint: Fix what launch.py reports

checks.label: Lighthouse (mobile) 90+ on home and two inner pages
checks.hint: Needs a public staging URL (it's sent to Google PageSpeed Insights). Behind a password? Run Lighthouse in Chrome DevTools, then `bin/asf skip G4 lighthouse --reason "scores …"`

manual: Colour contrast passes (qa/contrast.js) in every colour context, and a keyboard-only pass reaches the menu, every link and the form
Block editor shows zero invalid blocks
The enquiry form works end to end on staging, and the email arrives (not in spam)
Backups run daily at the host, are kept at least 30 days, and one restore has been tested
Uptime monitoring on the production URL alerts a named person
Every admin has a personal login, a strong password and two-factor authentication
The client signed off staging in writing

stages.title: Run
stages.question: Is the site doing its job, and what do we change next?

checks.label: Live in production
checks.hint: `bin/asf set deploy.production_url https://…`

checks.label: Production scan: no security or launch errors (rechecked weekly)
checks.hint: Fix what launch.py reports: a plugin update, a host change or an expiring certificate can undo launch work

checks.label: Live campaigns pass their checks; finished ones are closed
checks.hint: `bin/asf campaign check <slug>` shows what's wrong; close finished ones with `bin/asf campaign close <slug> --outcome keep|redirect|unpublish`

checks.label: Analytics connected
checks.hint: Set ASF_GA4_ID (or ASF_GTM_ID) on the site, then `bin/asf set measurement.analytics "GA4 G-XXXX"`

checks.label: AI-search prompts to track are listed
checks.hint: `bin/asf set measurement.prompts '["best … for …", "…"]'` (5 prompts buyers would ask)

checks.label: This week's numbers collected
checks.hint: `bin/asf report` (or /asf report)

checks.label: This week's report written (no [blanks] left)
checks.hint: /asf report: the agent writes "The three things" from the data; you review it

manual: This week's report was reviewed and sent to the client
It names one concrete action for the coming week, with an owner
